responsibility: Declares the data structures and helper routines that bridge core GIMPLE and SSA form. It defines the per-function gimple_df state holding SSA names, default definitions, virtual operands, rename flags, and transaction-restart mappings, along with inline accessors and operand-update helpers such as gimple_in_ssa_p, gimple_vuse_op, gimple_vdef_op, and update_stmt used throughout SSA-aware middle-end code.
